evidence.observation: The plan says the example verifies against “the shown sections joined with newlines,” then says it verifies “against the shown section only, as the packaged reading example does (H9).” In `src/gnd/examples/literature/reading.py:390-392`, the document is the newline-joined text of all attempted sections; the example writes no anchor sidecar. The proposed first-section test therefore does not test the claimed example behavior.

concerns.recommendation: Describe the packaged example as verifying the joined attempted sections without anchors. Keep the first-section case as a separate host configuration, and make the LR2 acceptance evidence distinguish those cases.
concerns.title: LR2 attributes single-section verification to an example that joins sections

evidence.observation: The plan says `project.md` binds every phase, claims whole-repository `uv run ruff check` exits 1, and selects `uv run ruff check src tests tools` plus a component-index check. At this checkout, `.codex/skills/process-phase/references/project.md:25-26` says to skip every component-index step, while `:166-169` requires whole-repository `uv run ruff check` and says a phase no longer names a narrower file list.

concerns.recommendation: Reconcile the binding project rules and the observed lint state, then name the resulting required gates consistently in the plan and phase specs.
concerns.title: The planned phase gates do not satisfy the binding project protocol

evidence.observation: R0.1 says “the default `gnd verify` payload and text keep their fields and bytes,” and LR1-C5 requires byte-identical default text. D7(b) says “the text output prints each failing verdict's rows under its line,” while §5 says default bytes stay “either way.” D7(b) specifies no opt-in switch.

concerns.recommendation: Make D7(b) explicitly opt-in, or state that selecting it requires amending R0.1 and LR1-C5 at the plan gate.
concerns.title: D7(b) cannot preserve default text bytes as written

response.summary: LR2 misstates the packaged example’s document scope; the phase gates conflict with binding project rules; D7(b) conflicts with the unchanged-default-text requirement.
